page.content:
Live-action Fantastic Four film with Chris Evans as Johnny Storm.

How Fantastic Four (2005 film) connects

  • Faction: Fantastic Four — The 2005 film adapts the Fantastic Four.
  • Character: Chris Evans as Human Torch — Chris Evans played Human Torch in Fantastic Four (2005 film).
  • Topic: Marvel — The 2005 film is a Marvel screen work, not a parent of the MCU.
  • Character: Human Torch — Fantastic Four (2005 film) adapts Johnny Storm / Human Torch.

What is Fantastic Four (2005 film)?

The 2005 Fantastic Four film, and its 2007 sequel, adapt Reed, Sue, Johnny, and Ben with Chris Evans as the Human Torch — a different screen saga from the MCU's Captain America films.

Key threads lead to Fantastic Four, Chris Evans as Human Torch, Marvel and Human Torch.
